name: Scribe v2
access: ElevenLabs API: Speech to Text (batch, with optional webhook)
ElevenAgents (the speech recognition of an agent defaults to Scribe Realtime)

voice.input_audio: audio files (AAC, AIFF, OGG, MP3, Opus, WAV, FLAC, M4A, WebM) and video files (MP4, AVI, MKV, MOV, WMV, FLV, WebM, MPEG, 3GPP); file_format pcm_s16le_16 (16 kHz mono 16-bit PCM) gives lower latency than an encoded file [el-stt-overview] [el-api-stt]
voice.output_audio: none: the output is text, with word timestamps, speaker labels and audio-event tags
languages: 90+ languages; the capability page groups them by word error rate: 36 at 5% or less, 21 at 5 to 10%, 18 at 10 to 20% and 19 above 25 up to 50% [el-stt-overview]
voice.turn_detection: none: a batch model for finished recordings; Scribe v2 Realtime serves live audio
voice.interruption: not applicable to a transcription model
voice.latency: Batch model, so no latency figure; Artificial Analysis measures a median speed factor of 83.2 (seconds of audio transcribed per second of processing) [aa-stt-board]. Files over 8 minutes are split into up to four parts and transcribed in parallel [el-stt-overview]
voice.session_limit: Up to 10 hours of audio per file in standard mode; file size up to 3 GB on the capability page and under 5 GB on the API reference; multichannel mode takes up to 5 channels [el-stt-overview] [el-api-stt]

pricing_usd_per_mtok.notes: Per hour of audio, not per token: US$0.22 per hour. The pricing page adds US$0.07 per hour for entity detection and US$0.05 per hour for keyterm prompting; the API reference states surcharges of 30% for entity detection, entity redaction and transcript editing, 20% for keyterms and 10% for speaker roles [el-pricing-api] [el-api-stt]. Artificial Analysis lists US$3.67 per 1,000 minutes, which equals the list rate [aa-stt-board]

benchmarks.name: Artificial Analysis AA-WER v2 index, non-streaming (word error rate, percent, lower is better)
benchmarks.setting: weighted mix of AA-AgentTalk (50%), VoxPopuli-Cleaned-AA (25%) and Earnings22-Cleaned-AA (25%)
